ios.desc:
Your travels, on a globe you can spin.

voyage turns the countries you've been to into a 3D Earth you can hold in your
hand. Tap a country to mark it visited, add the places you're dreaming about to
a wishlist, and watch your map fill in trip by trip.

Then stay sharp between trips — voyage has a daily geography challenge and three
quiz games covering all 206 countries and territories.

TRACK WHERE YOU'VE BEEN
• Tap any country on an interactive 3D globe to mark it visited
• Build a wishlist of the places you want to go next
• Prefer flat? Switch to a 2D world map at any time
• Three globe styles — stylized, natural, and realistic satellite
• Zoom in close, with every capital city marked by a star
• Tick off top cities and famous attractions in each country

EARN ACHIEVEMENTS
• Globetrotter — how much of the world have you actually covered?
• Capital Collector — for capital city completionists
• New Wonders of the World — all seven, one badge
• Explorer badges for each of the six inhabited continents
• Tap any medal to see it full screen and spin it

A NEW GEOGRAPHY PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• Guess the country from its silhouette, from its flag, or name its capital
• A fresh challenge daily, plus a calendar of past days to catch up on
• Your results sync across iPhone and iPad

THREE QUIZ GAMES
• Click the Country — find every country on the globe against the clock
• Name the Capital — type the capital of every country
• Name the Flag — identify the country from its flag
• Play the whole world, or one continent at a time
• Earn bronze, silver, and gold trophies and track your best runs

BUILT THE WAY APPS USED TO BE
• Completely free. No ads. No subscriptions. No account to create.
• Private by design — your data lives on your device and your own iCloud, and is
  never sent to third parties
• Syncs automatically across your devices via iCloud
• Full dark mode
• Open source — anyone can read the code
• An optional tip jar if you'd like to support development. Every feature is
  included either way.

Whether you're a frequent flyer keeping a travel log, a geography nerd who wants
a daily quiz, or someone building a bucket list of countries to visit, voyage
gives you a beautiful place to put it all.

Download it, spin the globe, and start filling in the map.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Free app to track countries you've travelled to

quotes.text:
I know this already exists, but most such apps cost money or are freemium. I wanted to create a travel tracking app that was completely free, open-source and with a modern, playful design.

So I did that (with the help of Claude). The result is a iOS app written in Swift. You can track countries, major cities, and attractions you've visited or want to visit. You earn achievements as you travel to new destinations. There are also daily geography challenges.

The app is available on app store, and the code is on my Github (https://github.com/AnmolS99/voyage).

Feedback is very welcome :)
